dex.text: Prefers its own tunnels to the company of anybody else. Pushes soil into little hills and considers this a perfectly good way to decorate a lawn.
dex.fact: Moles spend almost their whole lives underground, and the molehills on a lawn are soil pushed up from their tunnels.

dex.text: Digs beneath the village green, the church and the council offices, all in the same week. Rarely seen, and very often blamed for the lawn.
dex.fact: Moles have very small eyes, and they rely mostly on touch and smell to find their way.
